work.englishTitle: MAXQ Special Edition Vol. 5: Jeong Hanna
work.summary: Digital MAXQ Special Edition photobook featuring Korean fitness influencer Jeong Hanna (정한나). RIDI identifies the exact product as a 29-page PDF e-book released 2021-04-30. MAXQ's publisher article calls her the solo muse and cover model for MAXQSE 5 and describes it as an online photobook; Sports Seoul also identifies her as Vol. 5 muse. This is a distinct titled product from her Secret B Vol. 11 and the later Vol. 03 compilation; image overlap has not been checked. No ISBN is listed. No cover or paid PDF is copied because reuse permission for the exact asset is unconfirmed.

edition.contentSummary: RIDI lists MAXQ Special Edition 5 as a 29-page PDF e-book released 2021-04-30 and names its subtitle Perfect Body, Han-na. MAXQ's 2021-10-03 publisher article identifies Jeong Hanna as the solo MAXQSE 5 muse/cover model and says the online photobook was available through ebook sites and apps. No ISBN is listed. This record stores bibliographic metadata only; no cover or paid PDF is copied or mirrored.
